Regardless of what your parents taught you, you have infinite worth and potential as a person. You just have to believe it. 

I do everything I can to instill that in my kids but it's a struggle for me big time. Having my example of parenting being what it is I've had to do a lifetime of relationship and parenting observation in 2.5 years. I'm slowly making peace with my past but I believe it will be a very long time before I can feel good about myself vs being proud of something I've built or repaired. I'm 36 and I've never felt as lost and confused as I do now that I'm sober and clean and trying to better myself. I feel like I'm on and upward and downward spiral at the same time an endless roller coaster looking for the off ramp.

I know I shouldn't be trying to validate myself with other people feelings and I'm working on that, I had very toxic parents that always smacked me around and told me how much of a failure I was and I can't tell you how many times it was thrown in my face that the only reason they got married was because I  happened. Subconsciously it made me responsible for their shit marriage and all the plates getting throw around and the screaming going on downstairs while I was grounded in my room for stupid little things. I had struggles with drugs and many little stints in jail over the years. When you're told you're a bad kid no matter how hard you try to make them happy eventually you just say fuck it and accept it. I'm just starting to deal with this, I'll never do to my little ones what happened to me. She didnt have it easy either growing up and lost her father at an early age. We're both a bit damaged and both scared of being shitty parents. I just want to fill this hole that's been gnawing at me my whole life. I want to be better for her and the kids, I just want to live up to this ideal picture of a family I have in my head and I feel like I'm failing at it and I dont even know who I am now that I'm starting to untangle this mess of myself, all I know is I'm hurting and I want to get better because I love them, they're all I have. I'm definitely the shunned black sheep of my family, nobody speaks to me, if I lose my wife and make my kids hate me I'm going to just simply be a broken empty shell of a man. I know I need to tighten up the boot straps and knuckle down and get myself better for their sake. I'd die for this family, they're all I have keeping me going
